data.title: Solayer Pay Opens Stablecoin Deposits on Solana, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain and Base
data.description: Users can now fund their Solayer Pay balance from the network their stablecoins already sit on, then spend at Visa merchants worldwidePALO ALTO, California, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Solayer, the company building a hardware-accelerated SVM blockchain for real-time finance, today announced that Solayer Pay, its crypto-native Visa card and payments app, now accepts deposits on five networks: Solana, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain and Base.
